wu: Christmas Pictionary: Students draw Christmas words (tree, star, gift) from a hat while others guess. Props: whiteboard markers, hat, word cards. Students say 'It's a...' when guessing.
wuAlt: Christmas Charades: Students act out words like 'sing' or 'decorate' without speaking. Props: no props needed. Students mime actions and others guess.
Christmas Memory Chain: Each student adds a Christmas word to a chain, e.g., 'I see a tree, I see a star...' Props: no props needed. Students repeat the chain with each addition.
pres: Show Christmas flashcards (tree, star, gift, bell, carol) and model sentences: 'It's a Christmas tree.' 'I can sing a carol.' Check understanding by asking 'What is this?' and 'Can you...?'
presAlt: Use a Christmas storybook with pictures, pointing to items and saying their names. Props: storybook. Students repeat after the teacher.
Bring realia: a small tree, a bell, a gift box. Students touch and name items. Props: realia. Teacher asks 'What is this?' and students answer.
prac: Christmas Bingo: Students have bingo cards with pictures. Teacher calls words, students mark them. Props: bingo cards, markers. Teacher says 'Find the star.' and students respond by marking it.
pracAlt: Christmas Word Sort: Students sort flashcards into 'Christmas' and 'Not Christmas' piles. Props: flashcards, two boxes. Students say 'This is Christmas.' or 'This is not Christmas.'
Christmas Roleplay Pairs: Students ask and answer 'What do you see?' using flashcards. Props: flashcards. Students say 'I see a gift.' and 'What do you see?'
ls: Listen to a Christmas play audio. Students follow along with their scripts and highlight stage directions. Props: audio player, scripts. Students raise hands when they hear a direction like 'Santa enters'.
re: Christmas Freeze Dance: Play music, students dance when music stops, they freeze like a Christmas item. Props: music player. Students say 'I'm a tree!' when frozen.
prod: Group Play Practice: Students read and act the Christmas play in groups, using stage directions. Props: scripts, simple props (paper stars). Students perform a short scene for the class.
rw: Write a Christmas Programme: Students fill in cast names and scenes for the play. Props: programme templates, pencils. Students write 'Scene 1: Santa enters' and 'Cast: Ali, Sara'.
st: Sing 'Jingle Bells' with actions, then read a short Christmas story. End with the goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line. Props: storybook, stickers.
g: Students draw words from a hat while others guess.
Students act out words like 'sing' or 'decorate' without speaking.
Each student adds a Christmas word to a chain, e.g., 'I see a tree, I see a star...'
Students mark pictures on bingo cards as teacher calls words.
Students dance and freeze like Christmas items when music stops.
diff: Fast finishers / stronger learners: Write 3 sentences about their ideal Christmas party.
Support / weaker learners: Use word banks to fill in the programme template.
hw: Read the Christmas page in your mini-book and circle 3 new words.
Draw a picture of your favorite Christmas item and label it in English.
Ask a family member about their Christmas traditions and write 2 sentences.
tip: Use Moroccan Christmas traditions (like sharing sweets) to connect the theme locally, making the lesson more relatable and engaging for students.
